reel.caption:
Do your parents get a pension? 30 November is the life-certificate deadline.

Pensioners aged 80 and above could submit from 1 October. Everyone else submits between 1 and 30 November.
Miss it and the pension can be put on hold until the certificate is in. The held months are paid later.
It can be done at home with a face scan on a phone, or by fingerprint at a bank or post office.

Have your parents done theirs yet?

Sources: a central government pensions department schedule as reported by two personal-finance news sites (Sep and Oct 2026), and a personal-finance deadline checklist (1 Oct 2026).

For education only. Not investment advice.
Voiceover is AI-generated.
